update_notice.output_tokens.title: (Notice) Output token limit settings
update_notice.output_tokens.body:
You can now set an output token limit for every API connection.

The default is 8192 for new connections and connections without a saved limit. Existing limits saved for NanoGPT connections are retained.

To adjust a limit, edit the connection under Settings > API connections.
